values: Soil prokaryote (bacteria and archaea) community composition, diversity and function from eDNA metabarcoding of the 16S rRNA V4 region
Soil fungal community composition, diversity and function from eDNA metabarcoding of the ITS2 region

command: analysis_method_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES observation_utility.analysis_method (id)
method_pipeline_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES observation_utility.method_pipeline (id)
stage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stage IN ('laboratory','bioinformatics'))

sql:
INSERT INTO observation_utility.method_pipeline (name, analysis_method_id, abstract)
SELECT v.name, am.id, v.abstract FROM (VALUES
('ai4sh-16s', 'ai4sh 16s metabarcoding', 'Soil prokaryote (bacteria and archaea) community composition, diversity and function from eDNA metabarcoding of the 16S rRNA V4 region'),
('ai4sh-its', 'ai4sh its metabarcoding', 'Soil fungal community composition, diversity and function from eDNA metabarcoding of the ITS2 region')
) AS v(name, analysis_method, abstract)
JOIN observation_utility.analysis_method am ON am.name = v.analysis_method
ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING;

DO $body$
DECLARE v_missing TEXT;
BEGIN
    CREATE TEMP TABLE _pipeline_step_seed ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT v.*, p.id AS method_pipeline_id, lp.id AS lab_protocol_id, pp.id AS edna_primer_pair_id, sw.id AS software_id, tr.id AS taxonomy_reference_id
    FROM (VALUES
('ai4sh-16s', 1, 'laboratory', 'extraction', 'zymobiomics dna miniprep', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{}', 'DNA extraction from soil'),
('ai4sh-16s', 2, 'laboratory', 'amplification', 'pcr amplification', '515f-806r modified', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{}', 'PCR amplification of the marker region with forward and reverse primer used together'),
('ai4sh-16s', 3, 'laboratory', 'purification', 'magnetic bead purification', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{}', 'Purification of amplicons'),
('ai4sh-16s', 4, 'laboratory', 'sequencing', 'illumina pe250', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{}', 'Amplicon sequencing'),
('ai4sh-16s', 5, 'bioinformatics', 'demultiplexing and primer trimming', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{"barcode_mismatches": null, "primer_trimming": true}', 'Assigns pooled reads to samples by barcode and removes barcode and primer sequences'),
('ai4sh-16s', 6, 'bioinformatics', 'paired-end merging', NULL, NULL, 'flash', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{"min_overlap": null, "max_overlap": null, "max_mismatch_density": null}', 'Merges forward and reverse reads into tags'),
('ai4sh-16s', 7, 'bioinformatics', 'quality filtering', NULL, NULL, 'fastp', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{"min_phred_score": null, "min_length": null}', 'Removes low quality tags'),
('ai4sh-16s', 8, 'bioinformatics', 'chimera removal', NULL, NULL, 'vsearch', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{"method": null}', 'Detects and removes chimeric sequences, yielding effective tags'),
('ai4sh-16s', 9, 'bioinformatics', 'asv inference', NULL, NULL, 'dada2', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{"trunc_len_forward": null, "trunc_len_reverse": null}', 'Denoising into amplicon sequence variants (ASV)'),
('ai4sh-16s', 10, 'bioinformatics', 'taxonomic annotation', NULL, NULL, 'qiime2', '2024.10', 'silva', 'unspecified', '{"classifier": null, "confidence_threshold": null}', 'Assigns taxonomy to each ASV against the taxonomy reference'),
('ai4sh-16s', 11, 'bioinformatics', 'functional prediction', NULL, NULL, 'faprotax', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{}', 'Maps annotated taxa to ecological functions'),
('ai4sh-16s', 12, 'bioinformatics', 'diversity indices', NULL, NULL, 'qiime2', '2024.10', NULL, NULL, '{"indices": ["observed_richness", "chao1", "dominance", "pielou_e", "shannon", "simpson"], "rarefaction_depth": 20000}', 'Alpha diversity indices per sample'),
('ai4sh-its', 1, 'laboratory', 'extraction', 'zymobiomics dna miniprep', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{}', 'DNA extraction from soil'),
('ai4sh-its', 2, 'laboratory', 'amplification', 'pcr amplification', 'gits7-its4', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{}', 'PCR amplification of the marker region with forward and reverse primer used together'),
('ai4sh-its', 3, 'laboratory', 'purification', 'magnetic bead purification', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{}', 'Purification of amplicons'),
('ai4sh-its', 4, 'laboratory', 'sequencing', 'illumina pe250', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{}', 'Amplicon sequencing'),
('ai4sh-its', 5, 'bioinformatics', 'demultiplexing and primer trimming', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, '{"barcode_mismatches": null, "primer_trimming": true}', 'Assigns pooled reads to samples by barcode and removes barcode and primer sequences'),
('ai4sh-its', 6, 'bioinformatics', 'paired-end merging', NULL, NULL, 'flash', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{"min_overlap": null, "max_overlap": null, "max_mismatch_density": null}', 'Merges forward and reverse reads into tags'),
('ai4sh-its', 7, 'bioinformatics', 'quality filtering', NULL, NULL, 'fastp', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{"min_phred_score": null, "min_length": null}', 'Removes low quality tags'),
('ai4sh-its', 8, 'bioinformatics', 'chimera removal', NULL, NULL, 'vsearch', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{"method": null}', 'Detects and removes chimeric sequences, yielding effective tags'),
('ai4sh-its', 9, 'bioinformatics', 'asv inference', NULL, NULL, 'dada2', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{"trunc_len_forward": null, "trunc_len_reverse": null}', 'Denoising into amplicon sequence variants (ASV)'),
('ai4sh-its', 10, 'bioinformatics', 'taxonomic annotation', NULL, NULL, 'qiime2', '2024.10', 'unite', 'unspecified', '{"classifier": null, "confidence_threshold": null}', 'Assigns taxonomy to each ASV against the taxonomy reference'),
('ai4sh-its', 11, 'bioinformatics', 'functional prediction', NULL, NULL, 'funguild', 'unspecified', NULL, NULL, '{}', 'Maps annotated taxa to ecological functions'),
('ai4sh-its', 12, 'bioinformatics', 'diversity indices', NULL, NULL, 'qiime2', '2024.10', NULL, NULL, '{"indices": ["observed_richness", "chao1", "dominance", "pielou_e", "shannon", "simpson"], "rarefaction_depth": 20000}', 'Alpha diversity indices per sample')
    ) AS v(pipeline, step, stage, name, lab_protocol, primer_pair, software, software_version, taxonomy_reference, taxonomy_reference_version, parameters, abstract)
    LEFT JOIN observation_utility.method_pipeline p ON p.name = v.pipeline
    LEFT JOIN observation_utility.lab_protocol lp ON lp.name = v.lab_protocol
    LEFT JOIN observation_utility.edna_primer_pair pp ON pp.name = v.primer_pair
    LEFT JOIN observation_utility.software sw ON sw.name = v.software AND sw.version = v.software_version
    LEFT JOIN organism_utility.taxonomy_reference tr ON tr.name = v.taxonomy_reference AND tr.version = v.taxonomy_reference_version;
    SELECT string_agg(pipeline || ' step ' || step, ', ') INTO v_missing FROM _pipeline_step_seed
    WHERE method_pipeline_id IS NULL
       OR (lab_protocol IS NOT NULL AND lab_protocol_id IS NULL)
       OR (primer_pair IS NOT NULL AND edna_primer_pair_id IS NULL)
       OR (software IS NOT NULL AND software_id IS NULL)
       OR (taxonomy_reference IS NOT NULL AND taxonomy_reference_id IS NULL);
    IF v_missing IS NOT NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'method_pipeline_step seed: unresolved reference (name/version not in catalogue) for %', v_missing;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO observation_utility.method_pipeline_step (method_pipeline_id, step, stage, name, lab_protocol_id, edna_primer_pair_id, software_id, taxonomy_reference_id, parameters, abstract)
    SELECT method_pipeline_id, step::SMALLINT, stage, name, lab_protocol_id, edna_primer_pair_id, software_id, taxonomy_reference_id, parameters::JSONB, abstract FROM _pipeline_step_seed
    ON CONFLICT (method_pipeline_id, step) DO NOTHING;
END
$body$;
